span.p: Dispatcher feedback type?

span.p:
Explain existing decision
LLM reads stored evidence and computed comparisons
No schedule recomputation by default

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Correction or clarification
Preserve feedback evidence; update same task
Increase version and invalidate old verification/preview

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reverify current facts and constraints
Remaining blockers stay in clarification/review

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
What-if or new comparison
Call deterministic calculation tool
Changed requirements need a new preview

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Deterministic fresh preview
Current order, workshop and queue snapshot
Requested eligible alternative may be lower-ranked

div.style: color: rgb(86, 59, 21) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Confirm recommended or selected eligible option
Carry stable operation identity and preview version

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Still valid at commit time?
Task/assignment/queue versions,
live status and hard workshop constraints

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Stale preview or changed eligibility
Recalculate and return to dispatcher review
Do not commit the old preview

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p: New assignment or change of workshop?

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p: Existing work can be moved under agreed policy?

div.style: color: rgb(86, 59, 21) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Started/completed work or unclear remaining quantity
Resolve remaining-work, recall or rework policy
Do not erase work already performed

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
Transactional assignment service
New: reserve work and create assignment
Move: release only movable old work and reserve replacement
Append feedback, snapshots and assignment history

div.style: color: rgb(41, 52, 68) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Authoritative operational database
Assignments, reservations and outcome history
Duplicate operation is not a second assignment

div.style: color: rgb(20, 46, 81) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Committed outcome
Update dispatcher view and originating chat
Recorded instruction may be acted on operationally

div.style: color: rgb(86, 59, 21) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reject or cancel proposal
Record reason when supplied
Retain any previous assignment and reservation

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Transaction failure
Keep previous valid assignment/reservations
Show failure; no partial replacement

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Same workshop / repeated confirmation
No duplicate reservation or false move
